author: Yffe
content: FIXED in commit 2164770. Root cause: ens_implied_by_req used ANY-clause aggregation (returned Some(idx) on the first req-implied ens clause). Narrowed to ALL-clause aggregation: (c) fires only when EVERY ens clause is a req conjunct (or the whole req); a single genuinely-stronger clause (result == x) keeps the postcondition non-vacuous -> None. Single production file forge/src/vacuity.rs; also removed an unused Path import in forge/tests/divergence_vacuity.rs (clippy hygiene, no assertion changed, R-CHAR-3 preserved). Both pinned tests now PASS; control ens_fully_implied_by_req_still_rejects_c STILL rejects; oracle ens_eq_req/ens_conjunct_req still reject (c) and corpus sum/binary_search still L3. Gauntlet: cargo test -p forge 58 passed/0 failed/0 ignored; cargo test --workspace 0 failed; clippy -D warnings PASS; cargo fmt --all --check PASS. No conformance fixture or test assertion touched.
